name: Jared
title: Descendant of Seth
summary: Jared was a descendant of Seth in the godly line from Adam. He is known as the father of Enoch, who walked with God. Jared lived a total of 962 years, making him one of the longest-lived people in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Jared
keyEvents.description: Jared was born when his father Mahalalel was 65 years old. He belonged to the sixth generation after Adam through Seth's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Jared becomes the father of Enoch
keyEvents.description: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch, who later would become known for his unique relationship with God.

keyEvents.title: Jared's other descendants
keyEvents.description: After Enoch was born, Jared lived another 800 years and had more sons and daughters.

keyEvents.title: Jared's death
keyEvents.description: Jared lived a total of 962 years before he died. He is one of the longest-lived people mentioned in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Jared in Luke's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jared is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in Luke, which traces Jesus back to Adam through this patriarchal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Jared in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jared is mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles as part of the original lineage from Adam.
